description: Source code for PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) scheduling helpers, including functions for scrambling ID retrieval, PUCCH resource matching, and handling PUCCH PDUs (Protocol Data Units) for different formats.

classes.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler
classes.description: Handler class for managing existing PUCCH PDUs, including creation, updating, and removal based on PUCCH format and resource configurations.

methods.name: get_n_id0_scrambling
methods.description: Retrieves the scrambling ID 0 based on UE configuration and cell PCI, following 3GPP TS 38.211 specifications.

methods.name: sr_id_match
methods.description: Checks if a given PUCCH resource matches the SR (Scheduling Request) criteria.

methods.name: get_sr_pucch_resource
methods.description: Finds and returns the PUCCH resource associated with SR from the configuration.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::pucch_existing_pdus_handler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with RNTI, PUCCH info list, and configuration, and categorizing PDUs based on format and bits.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::get_next_pdu
methods.description: Provides the next available PUCCH PDU, creating new if necessary.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::remove_unused_pdus
methods.description: Removes unused PDUs associated with a specific RNTI.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_sr_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the SR PDU with new bits and invalidates the pointer.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_csi_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the CSI PDU with new bits and invalidates the pointer.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_harq_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates HARQ PDU bits, recomputes PRB allocation for formats 2 and 3, and invalidates the pointer.
